VERIFIED chat path is Java-only: a grep for DocServiceClient/RestDocServiceClient across service/** returns matches ONLY in DocumentService (ingest). ChatService + RetrievalService depend solely on ChunkRepository, EmbeddingClient, LlmClient. Hybrid retrieval = native pgvector cosine (embedding <=> CAST(? AS vector)) + full-text (tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('simple',?) with ts_rank), fused by ReciprocalRankFusion; citations trace chunk_id/document_id/block_ids/page/bbox/heading_path; a stage=citation-validate step drops any citation not tracing to a retrieved chunk.

VERIFIED interfaces + stubs active by default: StubLlmClient @Conditional(GeminiEnabledCondition.Disabled); StubEmbeddingClient @ConditionalOnMissingBean(primaryEmbeddingClient), deterministic hash-seeded L2-normalized float[384]. GeminiLlmClient is @Primary + @Conditional(GeminiEnabledCondition) and activates only when gemini.api.keys has a non-empty CSV entry (the custom Condition correctly distinguishes empty-vs-set, which @ConditionalOnProperty cannot).
